headline: OPKO Health to Sell Select BioReference Assets to Labcorp for $722M
summary: OPK's $722M BioReference asset sale to Labcorp, with a potential $150M earnout, aims to sharpen its biopharma focus and expand access to the 4Kscore Test.

headline: PACS Group, Inc. (PACS) Surges 6.2%: Is This an Indication of Further Gains?
summary: PACS Group, Inc. (PACS) saw its shares surge in the last session with trading volume being higher than average. The latest trend in earnings estimate revisions may not translate into further price increase in the near term.

headline: Labcorp (LH) Stock Looks In Step With Its Cash Flow Outlook
summary: Labcorp Holdings has delivered a strong share price run in recent years, so the key issue now is whether the current US$325.07 level is properly supported by the cash it can generate. With investors already sitting on sizeable gains, the question is how closely the recent price action lines up with the company’s underlying cash flow profile. Over the past 3 years the stock has returned 68.8%. This puts real weight on whether that gain aligns with the cash the business is expected to produce...
